_comment: Machine-readable path sets for the CL advisory checks (t/4151, from CL rules #2, #3 and #9 in t/4109#3). Owned by the Computational Linguist; tier-check reads this file, so CL can change a set without a DevOps change. Globs use gitignore-style ** semantics, relative to the repo root. `exclude` applies to every set. Advisory only: a match produces a warning, never a failure.

owned_files_rule._comment: Rule #2. A PR that ADDS a file matching `paths` (or `name_tokens`) must also change research/comp-linguist/docs/owned-files.md. Modified or deleted files don't trigger. The waiver is the PR-body line `Owned-files: not prompt or metric code` (for a name-token false positive).
owned_files_rule.waiver_line: Owned-files: not prompt or metric code

name_tokens._comment: Also triggers on a NEW file directly in lib/debate/ (not a subfolder) whose basename contains one of these tokens, case-sensitive. Heuristic; the 14-day replay measures its false positives.

provenance_rule._comment: Rule #3. A PR that ADDS or MODIFIES a file matching `paths` must also change research/comp-linguist/docs/metric-provenance-register.md, or carry the PR-body waiver line `Provenance: unchanged` (refactors, comments, renames). These are the files that hold a metric, threshold, weight, lexicon or model pin with a register row.

schema_rule._comment: Rule #9. For a diff to `file`, read the normative field list FROM THE FILE ITSELF at `list_pointer`, using the BASE revision's list, so a PR can't narrow the list and change a field in the same diff. Any change under `list_pointer` itself is normative. Classification follows meta.change_control.semver: a removal, retype, or removal of an enum value from a normative field = MAJOR -> T2 plus a CL review request (it also meets the t/3361 Second Opinion bar). An addition-only normative change (new field, new enum value, new edge type) = MINOR -> T1 plus a CL+TL co-sign request. A change to `free_fields` only = PATCH -> no action. Any other non-normative path -> no action.
